lines.t: They offered me a seat at their table…
But the food was poisoned,
The smiles were rented,
And the price was my mouth.
No deal.
No seat at their table, no chain on my soul,
No peace with the dark just to stay in control.
They got lights, they got likes, they got gold,
But I’m not for sale, and I’m not going cold.
No seat at their table, I’m walking alone,
Truth in my lungs, got a fire in my bones.
They can build their little kingdom of chrome,
But I know where I’m from, and I know where I’m going.
They say, “Keep it soft, don’t make nobody mad,
Smile for the camera, make the truth look bad.”
Want a clean little message with the teeth pulled out,
Want a tame little God they can talk about.
But I seen what comfort does to a man,
Makes a cage feel safe when he forgets who he am.
Makes him call compromise “a better plan,”
Then wonder why his son don’t respect where he stand.
They got truth with a brand and a price tag,
Faith with a filter and a fake little mic flag.
Everybody “healed” till the mirror get dragged,
Everybody bold till obedience gets asked.
I don’t need their stage, I don’t need their invite,
I don’t need the room if it hates the light.
I’d rather lose friends than lose my sight,
Rather walk through the dark with YahuShua than dine
With the world where the lies look bright.
No seat at their table, no chain on my soul,
No peace with the dark just to stay in control.
They got lights, they got likes, they got gold,
But I’m not for sale, and I’m not going cold.
No seat at their table, I’m walking alone,
Truth in my lungs, got a fire in my bones.
They can build their little kingdom of chrome,
But I know where I’m from, and I know where I’m going.
I don’t hate the lost, I remember that pit,
I remember chasing things that never quite fit.
Trying to fill a hole with a win, with a hit,
With a little more noise, then a little more sin.
But mercy found me with the blade of truth,
Cut the ropes off my hands, put fire in the roof.
Now I’m done being numb, done wasting my youth,
Done calling it “freedom” when I’m owned by a loop.
So if I sound strange, then good—I’m strange.
If I don’t play along, then good—I changed.
I’m not trying to blend with a world gone deranged,
I’m trying to stay faithful when everything shakes.
I got love for the people, but no love for the lie,
No deal with deception just to keep my supply.
If I speak, let it cut; if I stand, let it shine,
If I fall, let me fall o
